corrections.reason: Both the zoomed image and Classical Ge'ez grammar ('እለ ሥሩዓን በእጓለ እመሕያው ወእሙራን ቦሙ ዘውእቶሙ...') confirm the complete word 'ቦሙ' (in them) at the end of line 9, not a wrapped prefix 'በመ-'.
The printed glyph in Column 2, Line 28 has the distinct top crossbar of 'ጂ' ('እንጂ'), which was misread as 'ዲ' ('እንዲ').
In traditional Andemta citation syntax following a Ge'ez quote ('ከመ ትኩን መራሂተ ለሃይማኖት ዓባይ'), the text reads 'እንዲይላታል' (as He calls her), split across the line break as 'እንዲ↵ይላታል'.
